content.short: TONCO is a concentrated-liquidity DEX on TON built for more capital-efficient swaps and liquidity positions.
content.description: TONCO is a TON DEX built around concentrated liquidity. Traders use it for swaps, while liquidity providers can place capital into tighter price ranges for better efficiency; the project also extends into prediction-style on-chain markets. The First DEX on TON with Concentrated Liquidity. TONCO - THE FIRST CONCENTRATED LIQUIDITY DEX ON TON TONCO Predictions are live. The experience is organized around why tonco?, next-gen liquidity model, powering defi on ton, and the first dex on ton with concentrated liquidity.
